2026-09-28 19:57:41 UTC - OverallVerdict: DISAGREE

Classification: user-directed operational setup. Product FR/TR/TEST coverage is not applicable. Read add-profile skill and all 19 global profile files in full before reviewing.

FAIL findings

1. Generated marker will be unreadable by the operator. Installer /tmp/mcpserver-setup/install-local-service.ps1:131 sets UMask=0027, while the marker is created as mcpserver using ordinary FileStream(Create) in /home/sharpninja/github/McpServer/src/McpServer.Services/Services/MarkerFileService.cs:221. Live getfacl shows no workspace default ACL; id sharpninja shows no mcpserver membership. Result: a new marker is service-owned mode 0640. Shutdown removes the marker (src/McpServer.Support.Mcp/Program.cs:837), so one-time chmod is insufficient. Add inherited, scoped operator access and verify readability as sharpninja after startup and restart. Apply the same ownership analysis to recreated files under docs/Project.

2. Existing database adoption lacks the approved conflict check. Installer /tmp/mcpserver-setup/install-local-service.ps1:90 creates the database only if absent, then unconditionally grants the newly created login db_owner; it never checks whether an existing database is compatible operator-approved state. The approved plan requires stopping on conflicting existing databases. Add a read-only preflight guard: absent database is acceptable; unexpected existing database stops before account/ACL/secret mutations unless compatibility has been established.

UNKNOWN findings

1. Runtime verification remains pending. Static inspection cannot establish SQL authentication, migration success, health, actual listening process, or four agent integrations. The script correctly labels its receipt “health and agent verification pending.” These are post-install gates, not reasons to invent successful results.
2. Review persistence is unavailable. AGENTS-README-FIRST.yaml is absent; no MCP session/turn was created or persisted. Parent must preserve complete review JSONL and replay the complete result when MCP becomes available. Session ID/request ID: unavailable.

PASS observations

- PowerShell parser reports 0 errors.
- Revised YAML selects sqlserver and database TODO storage, registers the correct workspace, and places vector/GraphRAG paths under /var/lib/mcpserver.
- Configuration precedence supports the protected environment connection string: src/McpServer.Support.Mcp/Program.cs:100 reapplies environment variables after YAML.
- SQL passwords are passed through process environment/stdin, not command arguments; service secret directory/file are protected.
- Service runs as a dedicated noninteractive account; binaries remain root-owned; endpoint is explicitly localhost.
- Existing account/unit/login/secret are refused rather than silently overwritten.
- Windows-only Nuke UpdateService cannot directly perform this approved Linux first installation. The explicit systemd plan authorizes the first-install mechanism; I do not flag that override as a violation.

Scores: accuracy 99%, completeness 94%. Findings are source-pinned; acceptance completeness remains below 98% because the permission/database issues and mandatory persistence are unresolved. Sub-98 completeness is a failed gate.

Counts: 7 PASS / 2 FAIL / 2 UNKNOWN. No installation executed; no files edited.
